description: Send the 6-digit code we emailed to the mailbox's address. Whoever sends it, the code proves that the workspace can read mail there. The right code confirms the address for this workspace, and the mailbox may send. A wrong code, or one a newer code replaced, answers 400 and counts a try; after 5 wrong tries the code stops working and a new one must be sent. No code waiting (it expired, was canceled or stopped) answers 409. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

code.description: The 6-digit code in the email we sent to the mailbox's address. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: confirm_mailbox_address
title: Confirm a mailbox's address
